language_rules.register: Formal, clear, and specific British English (e.g. programme, organise).
principles: Keep every claim consistent with the CAS, transcripts, CV, finances, and supporting evidence.
Write to reduce doubt, not to impress.
Do not add facts that cannot be proven.
Keep the document tailored to the exact institution and course.

banned_phrases: I want to settle in the UK permanently
I chose the UK for migration
This course is only for visa purposes
Any university in the UK is fine
I have no specific academic reason
My sponsor will cover everything without proof
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: I plan to use this qualification to develop my career after graduation.
preferred_replacements.any university in the UK is fine: This university offers the specialization I need.
